resume: Translate entire PDF books and documents on your own machine — no data ever sent to the cloud.
besoin: Read a document in your language without handing it to an online service. toledo splits the PDF into chapters, translates it with a local LLM (Ollama), and can also convert it to Markdown, generate per-chapter study sheets or read it aloud.

resume: Project your retirement from a few parameters, without an intimidating spreadsheet.
besoin: Answer the simple question “does this hold up?”: savings, returns, horizon, withdrawals — and see how each assumption changes the outcome.

resume: Gather Spanish property listings into a single dashboard.
besoin: Looking for property in Spain means juggling several portals. valencia centralizes listings in a local database and presents them in a filterable dashboard to compare and track the market.

resume: A personal dashboard to track an investment portfolio.
besoin: See all your positions, their evolution and allocation without depending on each broker's interface.

resume: Learn advanced trading concepts — like the options wheel strategy — through simulation.
besoin: Options strategies are hard to learn from books. barcelona makes them tangible: you simulate, you fail, you understand — without risking a dollar.

roadmap.titre: Web simulator for the wheel strategy
